name: Regent Santa Monica Beach
positioning: Luxury hotel on Ocean Avenue in Santa Monica, near the pier and beach, with Orla by Michael Mina and a Guerlain spa
best_for: Travelers who want a Santa Monica base near the pier and beach
Spa-focused stays at the Guerlain Wellness Spa
Families and guests traveling with pets

facts.text: The hotel is at 1700 Ocean Avenue in Santa Monica.
The hotel is steps from the historic Santa Monica Pier.
At Orla by Michael Mina, chef Michael Mina serves cuisine inspired by his Greek and Egyptian upbringing.
Azure Bar serves poolside cuisine and cocktails with views of the Pacific Ocean.
Sweet July Cafe has a menu inspired by its founder, Ayesha Curry.
The Guerlain Wellness Spa covers 10,000 square feet.
The spa has a sauna, steam room and plunge pools in each locker room, plus a co-ed Champagne room for relaxing before or after treatments.
Rooms and suites come standard with entry foyers and separate living areas.
Rooms have spa-like bathrooms and walk-in closets with vanity seating.
For families, the hotel partners with Cybex for strollers and Nestig for cribs and toddler beds.
Pets are welcomed through the Tides & Tails program of pet amenities and services.
Surf lessons are offered steps from the hotel's beach access.

highlights.text: The property previously housed a Loews Hotel; its original atrium was kept and now serves as the main lobby and restaurant.
The spa is the first Guerlain Spa on the West Coast.
Orla here is Michael Mina's second outpost of the restaurant; the first is at Mandalay Bay in Las Vegas.
Beach butler service is complimentary with a stay, including chair and umbrella setups and food and beverage service.
Orla's private dining rooms take the Odyssey as their muse, with a custom mosaic floor depicting fish and octopus.

considerations.text: The hotel is a few hundred yards from the beach rather than directly on the sand.
The hotel charges a resort fee; the Regent House Car is included within it and offered on a first-arrival basis.
WhataHotel notes the bustling beachside location may feel lively for guests seeking a secluded retreat.
